items.title: Spike: red test reproducing false-stale under wrapper-root + custom storyDir metadata-only commit
items.context: Per the Debugging Contract, first nail the repro. Build a failing test: wrapper-root layout (metadataRoot != gitRoot) with a custom storyDir declared in lattice.config.json; start a review run, make a metadata-only commit to the custom storyDir, then assert the review run is WRONGLY flagged stale by assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence / collectReviewerEvidenceState. The test MUST fail before the fix (observe -> reproduce -> isolate -> confirm).

items.title: Thread metadataRoot through captureReviewRunSnapshot + diagnoseReviewRunSnapshot (production side)
items.context: review_run_start (handlers/review-run.ts:102) passes signedWorkspaceRoot only. Add a metadataRoot param to captureReviewRunSnapshot/diagnoseReviewRunSnapshot and pass workspace.metadataRoot || ctx.root so run.materialHash/storyFilesHash and the workspaceBinding sign with the storyDir-aware exclusion set. Default metadataRoot=projectRoot to keep plain repos byte-identical.

items.title: Thread metadataRoot into the two consumer freshness checks
items.context: assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence (core/review-run.ts:686) and validateEvidenceRunBinding (core/review-run.ts:826) pass signedProjectRoot as the metadataRoot arg. Change arg4 to run.workspaceBinding?.metadataRoot ?? projectRoot while keeping gitCwd=signedProjectRoot. Legacy runs without workspaceBinding fall back to projectRoot (behavior unchanged).

items.title: Turn red test green + regression guards
items.context: Confirm the CHK-001 repro now passes. Add/keep guards proving plain-repo + default-storyDir hashes and freshness stay byte-identical (no divergence vs DONE gate semantics). Run lattice validate all green.
